body:
"Robert" points out that Kaczynski
in ISAIF Para. 18 states what he
describes as the "leftist" approach:

"Thus if a person is 'inferior' it 
is not his fault, but society's, because he has 
not been brought up properly."

In his diary, Kaczynski spoke of his
own feelings of inferiority, and
attributed it to his having not been up properly.

"Suppose that for a period of years 
whenever you touched -- let us say -- a banana, you got a severe electric
shock. After that you would always be nervous around bananas, even if you knew
they weren't wired to shock you.  Well, in the same way, the many rejections,
humiliations and other painful influences that I underwent during adolescence
at home, in high school, and at Harvard have conditioned me to be afraid of
people."
		Letter from Ted Kaczynski		

Rather than blaming himself for
having a maladjusted personality, he 
blames his personality defects on society,
and on his not having been brought
up properly.   

How many here think that TK is
responsible for his own problems,
and how many think it is society's
fault or on his not having been 
brought up properly?

How many think it was the 
incident, at six months,
when he was tied down for 
hives for a week -- at a time
critical to the development
of neurological interconnections?
